title: Coupling and Maximal Inequalities for Graph-Dependent Empirical Processes
abstract: arXiv:2606.31936v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We develop maximal inequalities for empirical processes indexed by graph-dependent observations. Our bounds separate the complexity of the indexing class from two features specific to graph dependence: the geometry of the underlying graph and the cost of coupling graph-separated blocks to independent copies. The coupling construction combines a novel graph-adapted dependence coefficient with a coloring of a block partition. As an application, we derive Glivenko--Cantelli results and characterize the associated effective sample size. A central implication is that graph-dependent empirical processes need not exhibit a generic root-$n$ rate: convergence is jointly determined by function-class complexity, graph geometry, and the decay of dependence with graph distance. translated_title: 图依赖经验过程的耦合与极大不等式
translated_abstract: 我们为以图依赖观测为索引的经验过程建立了极大不等式。我们的界将索引类的复杂度与图依赖特有的两个特征分离开来：底层图的几何结构，以及将图分离的块耦合到独立副本所需的代价。该耦合构造将一种新颖的图适配依赖系数与块划分的染色方法相结合。作为应用，我们导出了Glivenko--Cantelli结果并刻画了相应的有效样本量。一个核心结论是：图依赖经验过程并不必然表现出通用的根号n收敛速率——收敛性由函数类复杂度、图几何结构以及依赖随图距离衰减的速度共同决定。我们将结果具体化到具有多项式增长和指数增长的图以及有向二叉（dyadic）图。最后，我们将这些结果应用于网络自回归模型。
tldr: 本文为图依赖经验过程建立了将函数类复杂度、图几何结构与耦合代价相分离的极大不等式，揭示了其收敛速率由三者共同决定而不必然是通用的根号n速率，并应用于Glivenko--Cantelli理论、有效样本量刻画及网络自回归模型。
en_tdlr: This paper develops maximal inequalities for graph-dependent empirical processes that separate function-class complexity, graph geometry, and coupling costs, showing that convergence rates are jointly determined by these factors rather than being generically root-n.
